{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Build system label and includes CMakeLists.txt and subtree build configuration updates.",
      "band": "P4",
      "score": 0.15,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Build changes are incidental integration glue for the libmultiprocess subtree and IPC binaries. They do not address core build system issues, platform breakages, or Guix release reproducibility."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not carry the Docs label; documentation updates are minor and purely secondary to the IPC changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Incidental documentation updates do not make the PR a member of the docs category."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Directly touches IPC infrastructure, including libmultiprocess, capnp interface definitions, and bitcoin-node/bitcoin-wallet IPC socket management.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Advances the core multiprocess project by enabling separate wallet process communication with the node. Per the PR description, it introduces `-ipcconnect` and `-ipcbind` so `bitcoin-wallet` can connect to a running node over domain sockets, unblocking follow-up work in #19461."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches no block template generation or Mining interface code.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR has no connection to mining or block template construction."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not touch P2P networking, peer management, or wire protocol logic.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "IPC socket connections between local processes do not fall under P2P networking."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not alter the JSON-RPC server or bitcoin-cli interfaces.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Enabling wallet IPC connection is preparatory to future RPC serving from the wallet tool, but changes no RPC interface logic here."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test modifications are confined to testing the new IPC functionality itself.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests added to verify IPC behavior belong to the IPC area rather than general test framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies the standalone `bitcoin-wallet` tool covered by this category.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Expands `bitcoin-wallet` options with `-ipcconnect` to allow connecting to a running daemon instead of only operating offline. The immediate change only verifies the socket connection on startup, but it lays the foundation for online subcommands."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Utils/log/libs label and touches utility signal helpers and init files.",
      "band": "P4",
      "score": 0.15,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Modifications under `src/util/` and `src/init/` serve the IPC connection glue rather than delivering general-purpose utility or logging improvements."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Wallet label and modifies wallet process initialization and startup interfaces.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Enables the standalone wallet executable to connect to a node process, paving the way for online wallet operations like balance syncing. In this PR the change is limited to verifying node socket presence, leaving actual wallet feature integration to future work."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
